planets.delineation_text: The Moon in Taurus is in her Exaltation. By day, the emotional nature is stable, grounded, and materially focused. The native possesses a calm temperament and strong attachment to comfort, security, and sensory pleasure. The mother may have been nurturing but traditional. Health is generally robust. Valens notes excellent fertility and material prosperity.
planets.house_delineation_text: The Moon in the second house creates great wealth if she is waxing and well-aspected by Jupiter." It indicates gain through women, the mother, or the public.Condition: If waning or afflicted, it shows fluctuations in wealth—money comes and goes like the tides. The native's resources are unstable.House 5: Good Fortune (Bona Fortuna - Children/Pleasure)Saturn in the 5th:Delineation: "Saturn in this house denies children or destroys them." It is a placement of barrenness or sorrow through offspring. If well-dignified (e.g., in Capricorn), it may give children late in life who are serious or elderly in demeanor, but the relationship is cold.Jupiter in the 5th:Delineation: "Jupiter in the fifth house promises happiness from children and great joy." The native will be honored through their offspring. It also indicates luck in "finding things" and general prosperity (speculation).Mars in the 5th:Delineation: "Mars in the fifth house causes the death of children or miscarriages." It indicates dangerous pleasures, scandal through romance, and insubordinate children who cause grief.Sun in the 5th:Delineation: "The Sun in the fifth house gives few children, but they will be distinguished." It indicates a life of honor, theatricality, and public recognition. The native seeks to "shine" through their creations.Venus in the 5th:Delineation: "Venus in the fifth house is the joy of the chart." (Venus joys in the 5th). It grants beautiful children (mostly girls), success in love affairs, and a life of pleasure and luxury. The native is charming, artistic, and popular.Mercury in the 5th:Delineation: "Mercury in the fifth house gives intelligent children." It indicates gain through education, the arts, or writing. The native treats their children as students or friends.Moon in the 5th:Delineation: "The Moon in the fifth house gives many children and a fertile nature." It indicates a public life or fame, as the 5th is the "joy" of Venus and trine the Ascendant. The native is emotionally nourished by creativity.House 6: Bad Fortune (Mala Fortuna - Illness/Subordinates)Jupiter in the 6th:Delineation: "Jupiter in the sixth house is humbled." It denies the full power of the benefic. It can indicate health issues related to the liver or blood (excess), or gain through serving others (doctors/healers). In a night chart, it protects against the worst evils of the house (illness).Sun in the 6th:Delineation: "The Sun in the sixth house is contrary to his nature (the King serving)." It indicates a father of low status, ill health, or a father who is "obscured." The native may serve in a bureaucratic capacity but struggle for recognition. "Whatever evils were decreed are mitigated" if the chart is diurnal, but the native must work hard.Venus in the 6th:Delineation: "Venus in the sixth house gives wives of low social status or injury through women." It indicates venereal diseases or scandals with servants/employees. However, if well-aspected, the native may marry a subordinate who helps them.Mercury in the 6th:Delineation: "Mercury in the sixth house makes the native clever in service." They are good accountants, secretaries, or schemers. It can indicate mental anxiety, nervous disorders, or theft by servants.House 7: The Setting Place (Marriage/Open Enemies)Moon in the 7th:Delineation: "The Moon in the seventh house makes the native uxorious (ruled by the spouse)." It indicates a spouse who is changeable, moody, or travels frequently. If afflicted, public enemies arise from the female sex or the "mob".House 8: Idle Place (Epicataphora - Death/Other People's Money)Jupiter in the 8th:Delineation: "Jupiter in the eighth house gives a peaceful death." It indicates significant inheritance and gain from the dead. The native benefits from wills, legacies, and the resources of the partner. "Great glory of material power" if the Moon is also well placed.Mars in the 8th:Delineation: "Mars in the eighth house indicates a violent or sudden death." It destroys the partner's money. It indicates lawsuits regarding inheritance or accusations concerning the dead.Sun in the 8th:Delineation: "The Sun in the eighth house threatens a short life (if the Hyleg)." It indicates a father who dies early or loses his fortune. The native's vitality is obscured/hidden. It can indicate a career managing other people's money but without fame.Venus in the 8th:Delineation: "Venus in the eighth house gives a gentle death." It indicates gain through marriage (dowry) or inheritance from women. The partner is wealthy but may die first.Mercury in the 8th:Delineation: "Mercury in the eighth house makes the native involved in the management of other people's money (accountant/executor)." It can indicate death through respiratory issues or mental anguish.Moon in the 8th:Firmicus Special Delineation: "No planet rejoices in this house except the Moon, and then only in nocturnal charts." If the Moon is waxing in the 8th by night and well-aspected by Jupiter, "this portends the greatest good fortune and riches beyond measure". This is a rare "exception" rule in Hellenistic astrology.House 9: God (Deus - Travel/Religion/Dreams)Saturn in the 9th:Delineation: "Saturn in the ninth house makes famous magicians, philosophers, or temple priests." By night, it indicates "wrath of the gods," atheism, or heresy. The native may suffer during travel or be shipwrecked.Jupiter in the 9th:Delineation: "Jupiter in the ninth house makes high priests and interpreters of the divine." It gives prophetic dreams, wisdom, and successful long voyages. The Sun rejoices here (God), so Jupiter supports this solar joy.Mars in the 9th:Delineation: "Mars in the ninth house makes the native accused of blasphemy or heresy." It indicates danger in foreign lands (bandits/war). However, Firmicus notes it can make "exorcists" who drive away demons through force.Sun in the 9th:Delineation: "The Sun in the ninth house makes the native known in foreign lands." It indicates a religious or philosophical mind. The native seeks truth and may become a teacher or guru.Venus in the 9th:Delineation: "Venus in the ninth house makes the native pious and beloved by the gods." Gain through religious connections or foreign travel. They may marry a foreigner.Mercury in the 9th:Delineation: "Mercury in the ninth house makes astrologers, diviners, and philosophers." The native seeks knowledge from afar and learns foreign languages.Moon in the 9th:Delineation: "The Moon in the ninth house causes long journeys." The native is restless, seeks foreign cultures, and may live abroad ("the wandering Moon").House 10: Midheaven (Praxis - Action/Career)Jupiter in the 10th:Delineation: "Jupiter in the tenth house makes men heads of public business and leaders." Great honors, high rank, and political success. The native is a magistrate or ruler.Mars in the 10th:Delineation: "Mars in the tenth house brings glory through military action or force." However, if afflicted, it threatens a "fall from grace" or public scandal. It indicates a career involving iron, fire, or command.Sun in the 10th:Delineation: "The Sun in the tenth house promises great power and authority." The native is born to rule or achieves fame. They are visible to the world.Venus in the 10th:Delineation: "Venus in the tenth house makes the native popular and honored." Success comes easily and with grace. They may be famous in the arts or beloved by the people.Mercury in the 10th:Delineation: "Mercury in the tenth house makes orators, mathematicians, and administrators." Success through intellect, speech, and writing. They are the "voice" of authority.House 11: Good Spirit (Bonus Daemon - Friends/Hopes)Saturn in the 11th:Delineation: "Saturn in the eleventh house gives false friends or friends who are elderly." It can indicate realized hopes through hard work and time, but friendships are utilitarian or cold.Jupiter in the 11th:Delineation: "Jupiter in the eleventh house is the best placement." It gives powerful, wealthy friends who help the native. Hopes are fulfilled easily. The native has "good luck" through social networks.Mars in the 11th:Delineation: "Mars in the eleventh house causes strife among friends." Friends become enemies. It indicates conflict within groups or associations.Sun in the 11th:Delineation: "The Sun in the eleventh house gives noble friends and high ambitions." The native is helped by powerful people (kings/leaders).Venus in the 11th:Delineation: "Venus in the eleventh house gives friends who are artistic or women." Success through social connections. The native is "socially graceful".Mercury in the 11th:Delineation: "Mercury in the eleventh house gives intellectual friends." Gain through networks of information or trade.Moon in the 11th:Delineation: "The Moon in the eleventh house gives many acquaintances but few distinct friends." Friends are changeable or the native relies on the "mob" for support.House 12: Bad Spirit (Malus Daemon - Enemies/Self-Undoing)Jupiter in the 12th:Delineation: "Jupiter in the twelfth house destroys enemies." The benefic nature overcomes the malice of the house. It indicates secret wealth, gain from large animals (horses/cattle), or protection in times of crisis. The "Guardian Angel" placement.Mercury in the 12th:Delineation: "Mercury in the twelfth house makes the native intelligent but envious." They are good at uncovering secrets, acting as spies, or engaging in slander. It creates "pain in the ass" figures or those who suffer from mental anguish/slander.4.

rule_ledger.judgment: The Moon in Taurus is in her Exaltation. By day, the emotional nature is stable, grounded, and materially focused. The native possesses a calm temperament and strong attachment to comfort, security, and sensory pleasure. The mother may have been nurturing but traditional. Health is generally robust. Valens notes excellent fertility and material prosperity.

The Moon in the second house creates great wealth if she is waxing and well-aspected by Jupiter." It indicates gain through women, the mother, or the public.Condition: If waning or afflicted, it shows fluctuations in wealth—money comes and goes like the tides. The native's resources are unstable.House 5: Good Fortune (Bona Fortuna - Children/Pleasure)Saturn in the 5th:Delineation: "Saturn in this house denies children or destroys them." It is a placement of barrenness or sorrow through offspring. If well-dignified (e.g., in Capricorn), it may give children late in life who are serious or elderly in demeanor, but the relationship is cold.Jupiter in the 5th:Delineation: "Jupiter in the fifth house promises happiness from children and great joy." The native will be honored through their offspring. It also indicates luck in "finding things" and general prosperity (speculation).Mars in the 5th:Delineation: "Mars in the fifth house causes the death of children or miscarriages." It indicates dangerous pleasures, scandal through romance, and insubordinate children who cause grief.Sun in the 5th:Delineation: "The Sun in the fifth house gives few children, but they will be distinguished." It indicates a life of honor, theatricality, and public recognition. The native seeks to "shine" through their creations.Venus in the 5th:Delineation: "Venus in the fifth house is the joy of the chart." (Venus joys in the 5th). It grants beautiful children (mostly girls), success in love affairs, and a life of pleasure and luxury. The native is charming, artistic, and popular.Mercury in the 5th:Delineation: "Mercury in the fifth house gives intelligent children." It indicates gain through education, the arts, or writing. The native treats their children as students or friends.Moon in the 5th:Delineation: "The Moon in the fifth house gives many children and a fertile nature." It indicates a public life or fame, as the 5th is the "joy" of Venus and trine the Ascendant. The native is emotionally nourished by creativity.House 6: Bad Fortune (Mala Fortuna - Illness/Subordinates)Jupiter in the 6th:Delineation: "Jupiter in the sixth house is humbled." It denies the full power of the benefic. It can indicate health issues related to the liver or blood (excess), or gain through serving others (doctors/healers). In a night chart, it protects against the worst evils of the house (illness).Sun in the 6th:Delineation: "The Sun in the sixth house is contrary to his nature (the King serving)." It indicates a father of low status, ill health, or a father who is "obscured." The native may serve in a bureaucratic capacity but struggle for recognition. "Whatever evils were decreed are mitigated" if the chart is diurnal, but the native must work hard.Venus in the 6th:Delineation: "Venus in the sixth house gives wives of low social status or injury through women." It indicates venereal diseases or scandals with servants/employees. However, if well-aspected, the native may marry a subordinate who helps them.Mercury in the 6th:Delineation: "Mercury in the sixth house makes the native clever in service." They are good accountants, secretaries, or schemers. It can indicate mental anxiety, nervous disorders, or theft by servants.House 7: The Setting Place (Marriage/Open Enemies)Moon in the 7th:Delineation: "The Moon in the seventh house makes the native uxorious (ruled by the spouse)." It indicates a spouse who is changeable, moody, or travels frequently. If afflicted, public enemies arise from the female sex or the "mob".House 8: Idle Place (Epicataphora - Death/Other People's Money)Jupiter in the 8th:Delineation: "Jupiter in the eighth house gives a peaceful death." It indicates significant inheritance and gain from the dead. The native benefits from wills, legacies, and the resources of the partner. "Great glory of material power" if the Moon is also well placed.Mars in the 8th:Delineation: "Mars in the eighth house indicates a violent or sudden death." It destroys the partner's money. It indicates lawsuits regarding inheritance or accusations concerning the dead.Sun in the 8th:Delineation: "The Sun in the eighth house threatens a short life (if the Hyleg)." It indicates a father who dies early or loses his fortune. The native's vitality is obscured/hidden. It can indicate a career managing other people's money but without fame.Venus in the 8th:Delineation: "Venus in the eighth house gives a gentle death." It indicates gain through marriage (dowry) or inheritance from women. The partner is wealthy but may die first.Mercury in the 8th:Delineation: "Mercury in the eighth house makes the native involved in the management of other people's money (accountant/executor)." It can indicate death through respiratory issues or mental anguish.Moon in the 8th:Firmicus Special Delineation: "No planet rejoices in this house except the Moon, and then only in nocturnal charts." If the Moon is waxing in the 8th by night and well-aspected by Jupiter, "this portends the greatest good fortune and riches beyond measure". This is a rare "exception" rule in Hellenistic astrology.House 9: God (Deus - Travel/Religion/Dreams)Saturn in the 9th:Delineation: "Saturn in the ninth house makes famous magicians, philosophers, or temple priests." By night, it indicates "wrath of the gods," atheism, or heresy. The native may suffer during travel or be shipwrecked.Jupiter in the 9th:Delineation: "Jupiter in the ninth house makes high priests and interpreters of the divine." It gives prophetic dreams, wisdom, and successful long voyages. The Sun rejoices here (God), so Jupiter supports this solar joy.Mars in the 9th:Delineation: "Mars in the ninth house makes the native accused of blasphemy or heresy." It indicates danger in foreign lands (bandits/war). However, Firmicus notes it can make "exorcists" who drive away demons through force.Sun in the 9th:Delineation: "The Sun in the ninth house makes the native known in foreign lands." It indicates a religious or philosophical mind. The native seeks truth and may become a teacher or guru.Venus in the 9th:Delineation: "Venus in the ninth house makes the native pious and beloved by the gods." Gain through religious connections or foreign travel. They may marry a foreigner.Mercury in the 9th:Delineation: "Mercury in the ninth house makes astrologers, diviners, and philosophers." The native seeks knowledge from afar and learns foreign languages.Moon in the 9th:Delineation: "The Moon in the ninth house causes long journeys." The native is restless, seeks foreign cultures, and may live abroad ("the wandering Moon").House 10: Midheaven (Praxis - Action/Career)Jupiter in the 10th:Delineation: "Jupiter in the tenth house makes men heads of public business and leaders." Great honors, high rank, and political success. The native is a magistrate or ruler.Mars in the 10th:Delineation: "Mars in the tenth house brings glory through military action or force." However, if afflicted, it threatens a "fall from grace" or public scandal. It indicates a career involving iron, fire, or command.Sun in the 10th:Delineation: "The Sun in the tenth house promises great power and authority." The native is born to rule or achieves fame. They are visible to the world.Venus in the 10th:Delineation: "Venus in the tenth house makes the native popular and honored." Success comes easily and with grace. They may be famous in the arts or beloved by the people.Mercury in the 10th:Delineation: "Mercury in the tenth house makes orators, mathematicians, and administrators." Success through intellect, speech, and writing. They are the "voice" of authority.House 11: Good Spirit (Bonus Daemon - Friends/Hopes)Saturn in the 11th:Delineation: "Saturn in the eleventh house gives false friends or friends who are elderly." It can indicate realized hopes through hard work and time, but friendships are utilitarian or cold.Jupiter in the 11th:Delineation: "Jupiter in the eleventh house is the best placement." It gives powerful, wealthy friends who help the native. Hopes are fulfilled easily. The native has "good luck" through social networks.Mars in the 11th:Delineation: "Mars in the eleventh house causes strife among friends." Friends become enemies. It indicates conflict within groups or associations.Sun in the 11th:Delineation: "The Sun in the eleventh house gives noble friends and high ambitions." The native is helped by powerful people (kings/leaders).Venus in the 11th:Delineation: "Venus in the eleventh house gives friends who are artistic or women." Success through social connections. The native is "socially graceful".Mercury in the 11th:Delineation: "Mercury in the eleventh house gives intellectual friends." Gain through networks of information or trade.Moon in the 11th:Delineation: "The Moon in the eleventh house gives many acquaintances but few distinct friends." Friends are changeable or the native relies on the "mob" for support.House 12: Bad Spirit (Malus Daemon - Enemies/Self-Undoing)Jupiter in the 12th:Delineation: "Jupiter in the twelfth house destroys enemies." The benefic nature overcomes the malice of the house. It indicates secret wealth, gain from large animals (horses/cattle), or protection in times of crisis. The "Guardian Angel" placement.Mercury in the 12th:Delineation: "Mercury in the twelfth house makes the native intelligent but envious." They are good at uncovering secrets, acting as spies, or engaging in slander. It creates "pain in the ass" figures or those who suffer from mental anguish/slander.4.
